To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we synthesized and structurally and magnetetically characterized two novel complexes of Al(i) and Ga(i) containing semiquinonates and catecholates.
we have prepared and structurally and magnetismally characterized two new complexes of Al(iiii) and Ga(iiii).
we have synthesized and structurally characterized two novel metal complexes, which are based on semiquinonates.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and structural characterization of two distinct metal complexes with the same ligand.
the synthesis, characterization, and magnetic properties of a dimeric complex with an Al(iii)-semiquinonate bond, and the isolation of a new polymorph of a known Ga(iii) complex.
the synthesis, structural, and magnetic characterization of semiquinone-based metal complexes of Al and Ga.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reaction of Al(iii)/Ga(iii) chloride with the reduced form of 3,5-Di-tert-butyle-1,2-o-benzoquinones leads to two different products, depending on the nature of the metal ion.
a semiquinone-based Al(iii) complex can be obtained either as a dimeric or as a monomeric species, whereas a semiquinolate Ga(iii) complex exists as a monomere.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the coordination chemistry of semiquinones is much richer than what has been previously reported.
the semiquinone-based Al(iii) complexes can exist in solution in equilibrium with the corresponding monoanionic catecholes, which can be isolated as crystalline materials.

the semiquinone ligand is capable of stabilizing both monomeric and dimeric metal complexes, and this may be of importance in the design and synthesis of new materials with interesting magnetic properties.
